interface.title: Reorient (neuroanatomy/reorient, Heuer & Toro 2020, JOSS 5(53) 2670)
interface.stage_of_work: Data preprocessing: putting a raw MRI volume into a standard orientation and cropping it before scripted analysis
interface.what_it_is_for: Rotate and translate an MRI NIfTI volume by hand in three orthogonal views until it lines up with the anatomical axes. Draw a crop box around the brain. Export the affine matrix, the crop box and the reoriented, cropped NIfTI. The browser tool is the interactive half of the workflow. The downstream half is the companion script reorient.py, which takes the input file, the saved matrix, the saved selection and an output file and repeats the same transform outside the browser. This run did not exercise reorient.py.

data.note: bear_uchar.nii.gz (a bear brain, volume shape 225x328x210, 0.33 voxel size) was loaded with the Choose link on the drop box. Downloads I read: reorient.mat (a 4x4 voxel-to-world matrix as text), selection.txt ('-103 -156 -98 / 105 153 99'), and two reoriented.nii.gz files: 41,390,087 bytes with the whole-brain crop box and 217,192 bytes with the default 40-unit box. The size difference shows that the crop box sets the extent of the exported volume. The only uploadable file was the NIfTI, so the load and append buttons were tested only with that wrong file type.

tree.specific: Reorient a bear brain MRI toward stereotaxic planes (this run made partial pitch and yaw corrections), crop away the background, and save the rotation matrix, the selection box and the NIfTI

features.name: Tri-planar volume viewer with slice sliders
features.general: Show a 3D image as three perpendicular slices with orientation labels, and step through each axis with its own slider
features.specific: LR (sagittal), PA (coronal) and IS (axial) viewers with P/A/S/I/L/R labels, a crosshair, and a slice slider under each showing the slice index. Moving one slider does not move the crosshair in the other views
steps: Load a volume into the drop box
Read the orientation labels and crosshair in each view
Drag a view's slider to change its slice index
Read the index shown in the view's corner (e.g. LR: 62, IS: 45)
serves_tasks: Check how the scan's voxel axes relate to world axes
Step through slices along each axis

features.name: Drag-to-transform rigid registration with live affine readout
features.general: Choose a translate or rotate mode, drag directly on any of three views to move or turn the 3D object, see the forward and inverse transform matrices update as you go, and reset when needed
features.specific: The Translate/Rotate tool buttons plus dragging in a viewer change the MRI affine. World to voxel and Voxel to world refresh in the left panel. Reset Matrix restores the original
steps: Drag inside the sagittal, coronal or axial view
Watch all three views and both matrices update
Repeat in other views to build up rotations about all three axes
Press Reset Matrix to start over
serves_tasks: Rotate the volume about the axis normal to a view
Shift the volume so the region of interest is centred

features.name: 3D bounding box edited from orthogonal views
features.general: Fit a 3D crop box by dragging edge handles on 2D slice views, with the box's corner coordinates shown as text and a reset to the default
features.specific: The Select tool shows a box with four handles in each view. Dragging a handle moves that face, and the box is drawn in all three views. The Crop box readout shows the min and max corners. Reset Selection restores (-20,-20,-20)(20,20,20). Dragging inside the box does not move it
steps: Click Select so the box appears
Drag the top/bottom handles (S/I) in the sagittal or coronal view
Drag the P/A handles in the sagittal view
Drag the L/R handles in the axial or coronal view
serves_tasks: Draw a 3D crop box around the region of interest
Return the crop box to its default

features.name: Reproducible export of transform, region and resampled volume
features.general: Write the current transform and crop region to plain-text files a script can read, and export the transformed, cropped data. You are warned if the crop region was never changed from the default
features.specific: Save Rotation Matrix → reorient.mat (4x4 voxel-to-world, space-separated). Save Selection Box → selection.txt (min corner row, max corner row). Save Nifti → reoriented.nii.gz resampled inside the crop box, with a confirm if the box is still the default. All three are meant for use with reorient.py
steps: Finish the alignment and the crop box
Press Save Rotation Matrix and name the file
Press Save Selection Box and name the file
Press Save Nifti, answer the default-box warning if it appears, and name the file
serves_tasks: Save the transform matrix as text for a script
Save the crop region as text

screens_never_reached: A successfully loaded rotation matrix (Load New Rotation Matrix) or appended one (Append Rotation Matrix): only the NIfTI could be uploaded, so no .mat file could be given
A successfully loaded selection box from a text file: same reason
not_done: Goal 'continue earlier work: reload a previously saved rotation matrix (Load New Rotation Matrix), compose one onto the current affine (Append Rotation Matrix), or reload a saved selection box (Load Selection Box)' was not reached. The browser only lets the page receive bear_uchar.nii.gz, not the downloaded reorient.mat or selection.txt. Giving the NIfTI to Load Selection Box turned the Crop box readout into (NaN,undefined,undefined)(NaN,NaN,undefined) with no error (screens/024.webp); Reset Selection fixed it (screens/025.webp). Giving it to Append Rotation Matrix (screens/025.webp) and Load New Rotation Matrix (screens/029.webp) left the matrix silently unchanged. All three controls fail silently on a wrong file type
Re-running the transform outside the browser with reorient.py (input file, reorient.mat, selection.txt, output file) was not tried. It is not confirmed that the exports reproduce the reoriented NIfTI
Drag-and-drop loading onto the drop box was not tried; only the Choose file picker was used
The reoriented.nii.gz files are binary, so only their sizes were checked; their content and header were not, and they were not reloaded into the viewer

The small roll rotation made in the coronal view (screens/016.webp, matrix term -0.021) was not in the matrix after the next translate (screens/018.webp) or in the saved reorient.mat, which has no LR-coupling terms. Either the app dropped it or it was below display precision; I did not find out which. Full alignment to stereotaxic planes was therefore not shown
Rotating in the coronal view made the layout stack the views vertically at 1280 px width (screens/016.webp). Widening the window to 1400 px brought back the 2x2 grid (screens/017.webp)
Moving one view's slice slider did not move the crosshair in the other views (seen in the replay), so slicing is not linked across views. Only rotate and translate update all views
Report-a-bug and GitHub links go off-site and were not followed. The documentation page (doc.html) was read (screens/003.webp, screens/004.webp)
